text.2:126: And when Abraham prayed: My Lord! Make this a region of security and bestow upon its people fruits, such of them as believe in Allah and the Last Day, He answered: As for him who disbelieveth, I shall leave him in contentment for a while, then I shall compel him to the doom of Fire - a hapless journey's end!
text.3:196: Let not the vicissitude (of the success) of those who disbelieve, in the land, deceive thee (O Muhammad).
text.7:57: And He it is Who sendeth the winds as tidings heralding His mercy, till, when they bear a cloud heavy (with rain), We lead it to a dead land, and then cause water to descend thereon and thereby bring forth fruits of every kind. Thus bring We forth the dead. Haply ye may remember.
text.7:58: As for the good land, its vegetation cometh forth by permission of its Lord; while as for that which is bad, only the useless cometh forth (from it). Thus do We recount the tokens for people who give thanks.
text.14:35: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
text.16:7: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
text.35:9: And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection.
text.40:4: None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad).
text.50:36: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
text.89:8: The like of which was not created in the lands;
text.89:11: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
text.90:1: Nay, I swear by this city -
text.90:2: And thou art an indweller of this city -
text.95:3: And by this land made safe;
